svg.text: Hunter X: share of injected movers returned as moving
Real SPHEREx D2 frames, sparse and crowded fields pooled, 48 movers per field and cell. Peak SNR per visit. SNR 5, 10 and 20 never pass 2%: their lines lie on the floor.
